run_balance_cli_weighting: run the balance CLI to adjust survey weights using covariate columns on a CSV input file
test_balance_cli_with_methods: test the balance CLI with CBPS, IPW, or rake weighting methods on sample and target data
test_balance_cli_column_parsing: test that the balance CLI correctly parses comma-separated covariate and outcome column arguments
test_balance_cli_output_formats: test the balance CLI with custom output separators like tab or semicolon for CSV files
test_balance_cli_exception_handling: test the balance CLI succeed_on_weighting_failure flag to handle weighting errors gracefully
